random_seed.note: No RNG. The sweep re-classifies a precomputed importance matrix and reads a fixed beta vector.

_provenance.statistical_method: Exhaustive re-classification over the four-dimensional threshold grid, then an ordering predicate on per-capsule beta means (Primary Hub < Secondary Hub < Specialist < Generalist < Non-critical). Configurations whose ordering cannot be evaluated record null and are counted in neither the numerator nor n_evaluable.
